American Educator
American Educator
is a quarterly journal published by the
American Federation of Teachers
focusing on various issues about children and
education
. In mid-2011, its total circulation was over 900,000.
[
1
]
Recent authors include
E. D. Hirsch Jr.
,
Diane Ravitch
,
Richard W. Riley
,
Daniel T. Willingham
and
William Julius Wilson
. The journal is indexed by the
United States Department of Education
's Education Resources Information Center.
[
2
]
History
American Educator
was first published in the winter of 1977.
